title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: xAI ships Grok 4.5 — co-trained with Cursor and aimed squarely at code + agentic work
bullets.summary: Grok 4.5 (Jul 8) is xAI's smartest model yet, explicitly tuned for coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work, and trained jointly with Cursor — the latest sign that frontier labs are optimizing directly for agent runtimes rather than chat.
bullets.how: A routing-layer input, not a rebuild: bench Grok 4.5 against Sonnet 5 / Opus 4.8 for Construct coding + computer-use jobs, but keep provider-agnostic routing.

bullets.title: OpenAI launches GPT-Live — a full-duplex voice architecture replacing Advanced Voice Mode
bullets.summary: GPT-Live (Jul 8) is a native full-duplex voice stack (real-time interrupt/overlap) that supersedes turn-based Advanced Voice Mode.
bullets.how: Voice is the missing modality for Brand 9 Signs client-facing agents (front-desk, kiosk/signage, review-response callbacks); watch for an MCP/voice-agent surface before committing.

bullets.title: Prime Intellect raises $130M Series A to let enterprises train their OWN agents
bullets.summary: Radical-led round (Jul 8) funds infra for organizations to build/train bespoke agentic systems in-house rather than renting them.
bullets.how: This is PRAGMA's exact competitive frame ('own your operator, don't rent it'). Positive signal the build-your-own-agent thesis is capitalized; a potential infra reference point and positioning benchmark.

bullets.title: Featured ships an MCP server for PR agencies — vertical agency MCPs are now landing
bullets.summary: Featured (AI co-pilot for PR) made its MCP server GA (Jul 7), letting Claude/Cursor/VS Code drive PR/earned-media workflows directly from an MCP-compatible client.
bullets.how: First-mover proof that agency-vertical MCPs are appearing; maps straight to B9/PRAGMA's owned-presence + earned-media wedge. Evaluate wrapping it behind Pulse for client PR ops.

bullets.title: MCP 2026-07-28 spec RC + beta SDKs land — stateless core, MCP Apps (server-rendered UI), Tasks, deprecation policy
bullets.summary: The biggest protocol revision since launch is now RC with beta SDKs; the stateless core runs behind plain HTTP load balancers, and Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code/Copilot and Goose already run MCP Apps.
bullets.how: The stateless core is friendly to our failure mode (scans dying when a session/host closes), and MCP Apps means server-rendered UI could feed the V4 dashboard directly. Pin the version Construct agents speak and schedule the migration inside the 12-month window.

praxis_lesson: Two things moved on the same day (Jul 8): frontier labs are now co-training models with agent tools (Grok 4.5 x Cursor) while capital floods 'build-your-own-agent' infra (Prime Intellect). Both point the same direction — the durable moat is not the model but the orchestration + integration layer you own. The Construct's edge is to stay provider-agnostic at the model tier and go deep on owned MCP orchestration (wrap vertical MCPs like Featured behind Pulse), so a model swap or a new voice/agent surface is a config change, not a rebuild.
